# farag-improve results (auto-generated by analyze.py)

Operating points (all chosen on DS1 only): argmax; maxF1 = max macro-F1; maxAcc = max plain acc (identical to max OvR acc); SeConstr = max acc s.t. Se_S >= 81.6 and Se_V >= 95.0 on DS1 calibration data (Model 6 sensitivities; if infeasible on DS1, falls back to max macro Se = balanced accuracy).

Decision rule: argmax(log P + [0, bS, bV]).
